events.headline: Rippling AI adds plugins, skills and automations
events.summary: Rippling AI gets plugins, skills and automations that give it context about each employee's role, reusable prompts and workflow automation, all controlled by existing Rippling permissions.

events.headline: Rippling expands in New York and opens a Singapore office; Toronto, Chicago and Seattle offices planned
events.summary: Rippling's new 132,693 sq ft office at 330 West 34th St nearly doubles its New York space and will hold more than 1,000 employees. It also opened a Singapore office for Asia sales and marketing, plans a permanent Toronto office later in 2026, and has announced Chicago (2027) and Seattle offices.

events.headline: Rippling relaunches Automated Compliance with AI
events.summary: The relaunched product supports multiple compliance frameworks and adds automatic evidence collection, AI-assisted fixes, an auditor portal and public Trust Centers. The tracker shows only the date it was first seen, 2026-10-14, not an exact release date.

events.headline: Sun Life U.S. joins Rippling's Preferred Carrier Program
events.summary: Sun Life U.S. will connect directly with Rippling so benefits data such as eligibility, enrollment and coverage is exchanged automatically for small and mid-market employers. No financial terms were disclosed.

events.headline: Rippling + CrowdStrike endpoint protection built into Device Management
events.summary: Customers can buy and manage CrowdStrike Falcon Protect or Falcon Defend through Rippling, and see sensor status and threats alongside device details.

events.headline: Rippling gateway for controlling AI agents' tool access
events.summary: A new gateway lets admins set which tools AI agents may use, review a log of agent actions, and tie each agent's permissions to the user's role.
